name: The Demon’s Bride
source:
Life as a high schooler is dull—until your best friend shares the thrilling fantasy stories she writes. You’ve always had a soft spot for the villains, and now she’s written you into her next novel as one. But it’s just a story… isn’t it?

Before you know it, you're pulled into a fictional world where three gorgeous men are devoted to you. Everything seems perfect—until you realize you’ve become their demon princess, and they expect you to lead a plot to assassinate the human king!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.villainess&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
